name: Deciding records reach the pass
purpose: Measures whether a pass of AI that considers one solution is given the records its verdict depends on, the ones held only in the network (a recorded result, a finding, the parent, the children's coherence, a dependency's interface) included, within a size budget, closest first; and, at the paid stages, whether such a pass reaches the verdict the records support where a pass without them does not.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each arm on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the balanced score with [balance.solution_consideration].
disadvantages: The free stage checks that the deciding record is in the prompt, not that a model uses it; the cases are a synthetic repository shaped like one real incident plus this repository's own records.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the prompt of each case is assembled from the synthetic repository and this repository's records: seconds, no model] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a person approved one model call per arm: a cheap model judges the reputed candidate of the synthetic repository given the network prompt and given the record alone, and passes when only the first cites the measured loss] > sample [sample=sample:10 | real=yes | when=ten network-only cases from real repositories, with an approved budget]
command: esoi run solution_consideration --impl network_tiered; esoi run solution_consideration --impl definition_only
